executionDifficulty.basis: DunkTrickComplexity enum maps each trick (Rim Grazer to 720 Spin) to a base difficulty from 12.0 to 30.0. Performance scaling is applied based on takeoff velocity, flight vertical height, and degrees of rotation.

artisticStyle.basis: Derived from average of fluid motion, landing control, and aesthetic impact. Applies safety/style deductions for biomechanical issues: -1.5 for knee valgus, -1.0 for severe ankle pronation.

firstTrySuccess.basis: 10.0 pts for 1st attempt, 7.0 for 2nd, 4.0 for 3rd, and 1.0 for additional attempts.

timeLimit.basis: Official FIBA 75-second attempt window. If time limit is exceeded, a penalty scales at 3.0 pts base + 0.25 pts per second over, clamped to a maximum 10.0 pts deduction.

capabilities.runUp: Tracks athlete acceleration and horizontal translation across the calibrated ground floor.
capabilities.takeoffAngleAndVelocity: Computes vertical takeoff angle and impulse velocity vector from the initial jump frames.
capabilities.flightHangTime: Measures the duration (in seconds) that the average hip joint center remains above the baseline floor level.
capabilities.trickComplexity: Detects hand/wrist joint proximity relative to knees/shoulders (e.g. Eastbay under-the-leg pass) to classify active trick.
capabilities.landingImpactAndBalance: Analyzes left/right knee and ankle coordinates upon landing to identify knee valgus collapse or severe ankle pronation, providing visual feedback and style deductions.

simulation.modes: Includes high-fidelity procedural skeleton rendering for the 10 available dunk tricks and biomechanical landing scenarios, ideal for Simulator or automated UI test environments.

features.playerCards: Displays side-by-side player and opponent stat cards, including active Creator Cards, PRQ readiness, and avatar/tag credentials.
features.recordedClipPreviews: Integrates stylized clip preview widgets displaying active, verified telemetry data and looping visual skeleton feeds.
features.liveJudgesPanel: Displays 3 virtual judges (Randy, Dominique, and Lisa) who score both participants live across the WDA scoring heuristics. Supports typed consensus commentary and individual board reveal animations.

integrationNavigation.wiredState: Intercepts selection of '.basketballDunkContest' to launch DunkMatchmakingView in a fullscreen navigation stack, replacing the legacy 3D/headless placeholder with the flagship WDA Dunk Platform.

rewardsAndSave.shardCredits: +50 Evolution Shards credited on completion to UserProfile.evolutionShards
rewardsAndSave.prqRating: Updates competitive PRQ score via 'FELScoreManager.shared.applyClampedPrq(...)' using the official 'PRQ.rankingSessionPRQ(...)' formula (won vs lost, combo metrics, score differential, and neural drive).

compilationState: Clean Swift compilation, zero linter/type errors.
